services.title: Autophoretic Coating
services.short_description: Autophoretic® auto-deposition delivers enhanced corrosion performance for demanding applications such as vehicle frames and chassis components. This epoxy-acrylic urethane coating has excellent thermal stability, top-coatability, and flexibility.
services.long_description: “A-coat” as it is commonly called, is a waterborne process that depends on chemical reactions with ferrous surfaces to achieve deposition. This process can fully coat all heat resistant assembled parts, sub-assemblies, and assemblies of ferrous metals without coating the non-ferrous components. “Where it wets, it coats” is a familiar attribute of this autodeposition coating process. The process uniformly coats inside, outside, and edges of complex shapes and tubular structures, increasing corrosion resistance on the most corrosion prone part locations. PMP Inc. currently offers the Autophoretic®/Aquence™ 930™ coating, the latest technology offered in autophoretic coating. For ferrous applications, this coating meets all industry standards and requirements, and meets or exceeds the specs for traditional coating methods. This coating is available in black, but is an excellent primer for top-coating with powder or wet paint for different color requirements. The process is streamlined and can coat more than a truckload of components per shift.
sub_services: Uniform gloss and uniform coating thickness

services.title: Powder Coating
services.short_description: A decorative, protective finish for a wide range of industrial and consumer products, delivering outstanding corrosion resistance on a 16-gun robotic line.
services.long_description: The process involves electrically charged powder particles, a mixture of finely ground pigment and resin, that is sprayed onto the surface of a product that has been electrically grounded. The charged particles adhere to the grounded surfaces until heated and fused into a smooth coating in a curing oven. The result is a uniform, durable, high-quality finish that meets government specifications for performance and durability. The powder coating line at PMP can accommodate components up to 22 feet long x 5 feet high x 47 inches wide, with a weight capacity of up to 2000 pounds. Our line includes a six-stage iron phosphate washer assuring clean parts and excellent powder adhesion. The spray booth is equipped with 16 robotic spray guns that can also be operated manually if required. This line is best suited for small parts requiring high production, but we process orders ranging from 1 piece to entire truckloads daily. PMP has invested in a powder re-claim unit that contributes to higher efficiency, green technology, and a lower customer cost. Powder coating is RoHS compliant.

services.title: Zinc Plating
services.short_description: A fully submerged coating process that chemically converts the surface so zinc bonds to it — available through rack or barrel processing.
services.long_description: Zinc plating is a fully submerged coating process, beginning with an acid and/or caustic cleaning followed by a conversion coating of zinc. The process converts, or changes, the surface chemically, allowing the zinc to be bonded to the surface. At PMP Inc., our zinc plate coating is available through RACK or BARREL processing. Rack plating accommodates parts up to 10 feet long on the rack system. Barrel plating is best suited for small to medium size components. We offer clear and yellow chromate zinc coating. Zinc provides corrosion resistance and is cosmetically pleasing. At PMP, our zinc plating operation processes automotive parts, screws, nuts, bolts, component parts, and full assemblies for an array of different industries.
sub_services: Barrel plating for small to medium parts

services.title: Batch Painting
services.short_description: An alternative coating method for oversized or low-quantity items that don't suit automated application — in a room-sized 15' w x 20' l x 6' h booth and oven.
services.long_description: Batch painting enables PMP to provide customers with an alternative method of coating application for those items that don't suit the automated application, such as large over-sized items or individual and low-quantity runs. Large items can be coated using powder or wet paint. Our room-sized spray booth and oven can process parts as large as 15 feet wide x 20 feet long x 6 feet high, and parts up to 15 feet long can be accommodated in the batch booth system. Typical batch work includes individual motorcycle frames, sprint car frames, automotive parts, tractor trailer parts, combines for the agricultural industry, and government components requiring CARC (high temp, high chemical resistance) finishes that meet MIL, OMAH, and ANSI specifications. These specialty coatings are always applied in the batch process. PMP offers a wide range of coating colors, or we can custom match your specific color needs.

services.title: Custom Coating
services.short_description: Retail, commercial and industrial metal refinishing — from motorcycle frames and hubcaps to patio furniture and utility trailers.
services.long_description: Patriot Metal Products can accommodate all of your retail, commercial and industrial metal refinishing needs. Whether it is to customize your items, such as hubcaps and motorcycle frames, or to recycle and reuse those things that just need a facelift such as your patio furniture, PMP can provide you with a fresh metal finish. Even your old utility trailer can be powder coated to look brand new. A variety of powder coatings are available in a wide range of colors, or we can custom match your specific color needs. We offer a full service metal finishing process including blasting, pretreatment, coating, and curing. As a green company, we value the restoration process so you can recycle and reuse your valuable metal items.
sub_services: Wrought iron fencing, gates, lawn ornamentation

capabilities.title: Metal Fabrication
capabilities.body: PMP can be the sole source for your metal fabrication and coatings needs.

capabilities.title: Assembly
capabilities.body: If component parts require coating prior to assembly, we re-assemble components in customer-required configurations, including custom packaging and electrical component assembly.

capabilities.title: Grinding & Sanding
capabilities.body: A fully manual process, with capability from rough sanding to commercial grade grinding.

capabilities.title: Burn Off
capabilities.body: Parts as small as a nickel or as large as 6' d x 10' w x 4' w. PMP has 3 different sized burn-off ovens.

capabilities.title: Blasting & Wheel Abrading
capabilities.body: Surface profiles from smooth to coarse, with various media shot available. Automated and manual blasting processes, including room-sized blast.

capabilities.title: Dip Coating
capabilities.body: Using submersion, all exposed surfaces are coated with an average film build of 1 to 2 dry mils. An air-cured process used primarily as a primer application. Added in 2004 as a cost-effective process for large quantities.

capabilities.title: Testing & Laboratory
capabilities.body: An onsite state-of-the-art coating laboratory with various testing capabilities. We provide certifications of the processes and the performance criteria for varied customers and applications.

capabilities.title: Transportation
capabilities.body: Our location is easily accessible to the interstate system for ease of trucking. We run a fleet of three trucks — two tractor trailers and one straight side closed van. Expedite services are available when necessary.

about.story:
PMP Inc. is a multiple process custom coater, offering cost effective solutions for a variety of industries, including automotive, metal, furniture, agricultural equipment, fasteners, appliances, and many more. Our highly qualified and experienced staff is dedicated to serve the needs of our customers. Each year we look to continued growth while maintaining the confidence and needs of those customers.

With experience spanning over 30 years, PMP has provided their customers with the quality and service they demand and deserve. Over the years the company has expanded its coating capacity from powder coating and zinc plating to now include the latest Autophoretic (auto-deposition) process.

Autophoretic, or A-coat as it is commonly called, is approved by the automotive, agricultural equipment and furniture industries. The process is streamlined and can coat more than a truckload of components per shift. This ensures the quick turnaround our customers require.

Sixteen robotic spray guns assist manual spray operations in our powder coating process. A drive-in batch spray room and curing process was added to accommodate specialized and larger items. All our processes at Patriot Metal Products Inc. are supported with a state of the art coating laboratory.

We understand the value of customer relationships and work hard to ensure that trust with an ongoing commitment. PMP is proud to use green technology where available, and is always taking great strides to further their environmentally friendly practices.
